releases.name: Yo Skater
releases.summary: A 2D precision platformer/endless skateboarding game that lets you ollie, flip, grind and yoyo your way through an infinite range of terrain, traps and obstacles!

releases.name: Retro Robot Rescue
releases.summary: Guide M.R.1 through a corrupted robot factory, battle hostile machines, collect biomass, and upgrade at the Forge in this retro-inspired top-down arcade shooter.

releases.name: Mogami-tei R
releases.summary: A Japanese-style horror visual novel set in 1980s Japan. Five years after a mysterious disappearance, Yukari Kanzaki and Akane Kiryu enter the abandoned Mogami Mansion. Explore its hidden secrets, uncover its dark past, and face multiple endings shaped by your choices.

releases.name: Dune War
releases.summary: Explore the desert. Mine rare crystals. Build your base. Survive the machine assault. Dune War features a single-player intro campaign and an endless high-score mode where every run is a fight over who control the dunes.

releases.name: Casino of Time
releases.summary: Casino of Time is a roguelike game where you gamble with your time. Your time ticks down and you must try to earn enough time to survive as long as possible in the casino. A variety of permanent upgrades is provided every 2 minutes to tilt the odds in your favour!

releases.name: Starforge Reborn
releases.summary: Starforge Reborn is a gritty top-down 2D space roguelite. Salvage Crystals, Starforge Coins, & Starforge Holo Coins to upgrade your mobile Forge, unlock 8 ships & 20 support drones, fight 15 enemy types and 15 brutal bosses—single-player only, with Campaign permanence and run-only Survival builds.

releases.name: Word Farm (Grove)
releases.summary: A 2D pixel game where you can memorize words while farming, making word memorization no longer boring.

releases.name: Flak Duty
releases.summary: Flak Duty is a short, linear sci-fi visual novel about an operator whose routine shift inside an automated flak machine goes wrong. Read the story in an illustrated filmstrip format, with page navigation and light or dark reading modes.

releases.name: Words Of Power (Tsuperion Games)
releases.summary: Words of Power is a fill-in-the-blank style rogue like deck builder. Travel deep into the dungeon below and fight using the power of words! Construct sentences of devastating power and manipulate the sentences of your foes to turn the tides of battle.

releases.name: Depths of Providence
releases.summary: Depths of Providence is a turn-based roguelike JRPG through 100 procedurally generated floors. Your party enters at level 1 with empty pockets. Fight down through instant-death depths and escape with rare loot before you lose it all. Bank blue-chest relics forever and climb the daily leaderboard.

releases.name: WIND CAT SOLITAIRE
releases.summary: Welcome to a peaceful, nostalgic game of Solitaire. But beware: there's a fan blowing wind, and a cat is here too! Splendidly "parry" unreasonable cat punches, gather blown-away cards, and force your way to victory. A new sensation of action-interrupted Solitaire!

releases.name: Rule or Fall
releases.summary: Govern wisely in this narrative choice-based game set in the heart of the Middle Ages. Your choices will have a real impact on your entire adventure, the world and its characters! Skillfully manage your image and your throne to survive and prosper. Or fall.

releases.name: Miners, Moos & Miracles
releases.summary: Miners, Moos & Miracles is built from the ground up as an incremental idle game, wrapped in a nostalgic retro-styled shell. Manage a small homestead (gold, barley, milk, eggs, and more), then hop between a handful of themed mini-games tied together by the same world.

releases.name: Shanhai Exorcist: Yin-Yang Chronicles
releases.summary: Build a dual-faced deck, balance Yin and Yang, and lead one of four exorcist schools through a replayable roguelike journey. Read enemy intents, flip cards to change their effects, shape powerful synergies, and seal demons in tactical turn-based battles.
